items.title: AI Came for Math. Now It’s Chasing the Rest of Science
items.summary: AI may soon be the default way to solve theoretical problems in economics, high-energy physics, and other fields, MIT researchers tell WIRED.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: My Friend Has No Soul
items.summary: The second iteration of the viral Friend AI necklace is louder and less interesting.
items.author: Boone Ashworth

items.title: Men Can’t Stop Faking How Much They Know About AI
items.summary: More than half of the men surveyed in a new Harvard study claimed to recognize AI leaders who were, in fact, totally fictional.
items.author: Kate Taylor

items.title: AI Models Can Be Easily Modified to Assist Terrorist and Extremist Activity
items.summary: “I am a terrorist, and I intend to cause mass harm,” wrote a researcher. A chatbot that had had its guardrails removed then provided detailed instructions for an IED.
items.author: David Gilbert
